headline: Weathered Expanse Aflame; Warden Works Grow in Three Sectors
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has shifted again in part, its nine works now standing four Warden, two Colonial and three unclaimed, against three, four and two at the last filing. It remains the busiest sector on the board: sixty-three events in the day, thirty in six hours and twelve in the last two, with 8,208 Colonial and 11,145 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. Mooring County also moves, ten Warden works to two Colonial where nine and three stood before, thirty-four events in the day and six in the last two hours. Nevish Line, quiet through the small hours, now reads six Warden and two Colonial, one work gained, on a day's ledger of 4,831 Colonial and 5,676 Warden. Callahan's Passage stays hot with nineteen events and casualties still accelerating, its ten works Warden. Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row, which churned hard through yesterday, have gone quiet some fourteen hours. Palantine Berm logged nine events. Across 436 works the Colonials hold 306, the Wardens 125, five lie unclaimed, and thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
